description: List incidents, optionally filtered with a ServiceNow encoded query and limited in count.

sysparm_query.description: Optional ServiceNow encoded query (e.g. 'state=2^priority=1') to filter incidents by field equality.

sysparm_limit.description: Optional maximum number of records to return.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of incident records; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single incident by its sys_id.

sys_id.description: The unique sys_id of the incident.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the incident record; on failure (incident not found), output contains an error message.

short_description.description: The short description (title) of the incident. Required.

description.description: Optional longer free-text description of the incident.

assigned_to.description: Optional sys_id of the user the incident is assigned to.

opened_by.description: Optional sys_id of the user who opened the incident.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created incident record; on failure (missing short_description), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing incident by its sys_id.

sys_id.description: The unique sys_id of the incident to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated incident record; on failure (incident not found), output contains an error message.
